_comment: Flags exports a branch ADDS whose reference count across src/ is 1 — the declaration
alone. That is the 'built, tested, never wired' class: a symbol shipped by a wave that no
production path calls, green the whole way because every assertion pointed at the
WHY A DELTA AND NOT A CENSUS — the settled empirical negative, recorded so nobody
re-litigates it. Measured on src/lib/** at e8a9c05: 1,812 exports, 971 with zero
non-owning-file consumers — 475 runtime symbols WITH a test consumer, 350 type-only, 146
with no consumer anywhere. A whole-repo guard would demand ~971 allowlist rows, and the
475 bucket is CLAUDE.md's own MANDATED test-importable-seam pattern, so the guard would
fight the house style and be allowlisted into uselessness on day one. The same measurement
on the wave that shipped the defect: 23 new exports, 2 flagged — hoursUntilUtcDayReset (the
real defect) and dailyUsedFor (a second of the same class). Two rows per wave, not 971.
EXEMPT BY CONSTRUCTION, never by row:
· type-only exports (`export type` / `export interface`) — a type has no call site
· re-exports (`export { x } from` / `export * from`) — they declare nothing new
Both are handled in code, so no one can be tempted to allowlist an entire class.

_why: REPORT-first per house law (G-D). Both conditions must hold to flip to block: zero
unexplained hits AND the date passed. A numeric criterion alone can never fire if the
count does not heal; a date alone flips a guard that is still noisy.
not_before is +7d rather than the usual +14d because the measured signal is 2 flagged
out of 23 new exports on a real wave — a rate that does not need a fortnight of
observation to judge. Every run appends its count to the ledger, so the flip decision
reads a series rather than a guess.

name_exemptions.reason: Module-level cache/state reset seams. CLAUDE.md MANDATES them ('Module-level singleton caches need full reset + per-cache partial + read-only inspector'), they exist to be called from tests, and the leading underscore already marks them as non-API. Measured on the reference wave: 2 of the 23 new exports.

Same class, older naming (`_resetBinanceAdapterCaches`, `_setSnapshotForTest` siblings). Kept as a separate pattern rather than widened into the one above so a future rename does not silently exempt more than intended.

symbol_exemptions.reason: OPS-QUOTA-METER-SURFACE-CONFORMANCE-W1 CH1. The quota-surface conformance registry is CI-FACING BY DESIGN: its consumers are scripts/check-quota-surface-conformance.mjs (through dist/) and tests/unit/quota-surface-conformance.test.ts. Zero src/ consumers is the INTENDED end state rather than a wiring gap — a build-time contract that src/ imported would become a runtime dependency. This is an explanation, not a suppression: the row is still printed and counted as `exempt` on every run, and only `dark` scores the promotion criterion.

OPS-QUOTA-METER-SURFACE-CONFORMANCE-W1 CH1. The sentence every quota surface is judged against, held in code rather than in a wave document precisely so a later reader cannot widen it in prose. Asserted by tests/unit/quota-surface-conformance.test.ts; no src/ consumer by design, same rationale as QUOTA_SURFACES.
